purpose: Post-#253 (issue #185/#252) re-determination: does the MinimizationFailed molecule set change after PR #253's dg::generate_coords atom-coincidence fixes (root/ring-vertex collision, ring-fusion-order mismatch, new-island direct-bond anchor)?
method: ForceFieldPolicy::Mmff94BondAngleStrict via minimize_with_policy, deterministic (MinimizeConfig has no RNG/wall-clock component, max_steps=200 fixed budget) -- verified byte-identical across 2 back-to-back runs on the post-#253 side before trusting this comparison.
note: All 28 baseline MinimizationFailed molecules resolved to Ok, 0 remaining, 0 new failures. None of the 28 resolved molecules contain a fused-polycyclic-aromatic ring system (checked by SMILES inspection) -- the anthracene-class fused-ring-seam limitation found during PR #253's review is not implicated in this population. This measurement does not establish which individual PR #253 sub-fix was causal for each molecule; that would require an additional ablation study (see issue #252's closing comment).
